brand.summary: Grizzly Energy is a halal-certified energy drink made in Pakistan by Grizzly Energy Beverage Labs. Every 250 ml can is made with natural caffeine from green coffee beans, B vitamins, electrolytes from sea salt and added Zamzam water, with no artificial colors and no preservatives. It comes in six flavors: Blue Raspberry, Mango Fuego, Watermelon, Strawberry Kiwi, Peach and Blackout Berry (a limited edition). Its tagline is “Fuel your wild side”.
